name: 45377 · Vandalia, OH
findings: ZIP 45377 (Vandalia) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45377 (Vandalia) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45377 (Vandalia) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 45377 (Vandalia) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
